text: Zwift, Inc., the US online fitness platform, is a venture-backed company: in September 2020 it announced a $450 million minority investment led by KKR, with new investors Permira, Specialized Bicycle Components' Zone 5 Ventures and the Amazon Alexa Fund and existing investors True, Highland Europe, Novator and Causeway Media.
short: Zwift's investors are venture funds (KKR, Permira and others).

source.name: Zwift newsroom: 'ZWIFT RAISES $450 MILLION INVESTMENT; SERIES C ROUND LED BY KKR'
source.quote: Zwift, the global online fitness platform for cyclists and runners, today announced a $450 million minority investment led by leading global investment firm KKR
source.note: Same release: 'accompanied by other new investors Permira, Specialized Bicycle Components’ venture capital fund, Zone 5 Ventures and the Amazon Alexa Fund and existing investors including True, Highland Europe, Novator and Causeway Media.'
